FIGHTS.title: Heavyweight title
FIGHTS.note: Gane retains in a close, debated fight. He outlanded Hokit 252-136 in sig strikes, but Hokit had 4:37 of control and 3 takedowns. Rounds per MMA Weekly: R1 Gane, R2 Hokit, R3 Hokit, R4 Gane (body kicks, knees), R5 Gane (stuffed takedowns). Hokit's first pro loss.

FIGHTS.title: Women's bantamweight title
FIGHTS.note: Harrison retains. R1 and R2 went to Harrison with takedowns and crucifix control. Nunes took R3 with body shots, a takedown to mount and a back take, though an elbow cut her forehead. In R4 Harrison caught a kick, took her down, took the back and finished the choke. (Round scores per MMA Weekly.) Live odds had swung toward Nunes early, with Harrison drifting from -166 to -125.

FIGHTS.title: Middleweight
FIGHTS.note: Borralho won every round on the mat: a back take with a body triangle and choke attempts in R1, two takedowns and elbows from side control in R2, and two more takedowns in R3.

FIGHTS.title: Welterweight
FIGHTS.note: Holland won R1 with uppercuts, a trip and two ninja choke attempts. Medic appeared to hurt his left knee early in R2, and R2 was paused for a Medic groin kick. Medic lost a point in R2 for a second low blow, which cost him the win. He rocked Holland late in R3 but could not finish.

FIGHTS.title: Flyweight
FIGHTS.note: Biggest upset of the night. Gurule dropped the unbeaten Hasan in R1, took him down in R2 and R3, and cut him with an elbow in R3.

FIGHTS.title: Welterweight
FIGHTS.note: Thompson's retirement fight. He snapped a three-fight skid and finishes his career at 18-9.

FIGHTS.title: Lightweight
FIGHTS.note: McKinney weighed 160.2, more than 4 lbs over, then needed under two minutes. Miller's 48th UFC fight.

FIGHTS.title: Middleweight
FIGHTS.note: Johnson's first pro loss. He came in unbeaten and favored.

FIGHTS.title: Women's bantamweight
FIGHTS.note: Mesquita called for a title shot after the finish.

FIGHTS.title: Bantamweight
FIGHTS.note: Diaz missed weight at 136.4. Heili took the fight on short notice.

FIGHTS.title: Lightweight
FIGHTS.note: Elder's first fight in about 19 months after a leg injury. Sanches was making his UFC debut.

NOTES.t: Luis Gurule (+675) beats unbeaten Bilal Hasan (-1050) by split decision after dropping him in R1.
Cesar Almeida (+154) stops unbeaten Donte Johnson in R1.
Stephen "Wonderboy" Thompson retires on a spinning wheel kick TKO of Charles Radtke. Final record 18-9.
Terrance McKinney (160.2 for lightweight) missed by more than 4 lbs, then stopped Jim Miller in 1:53.
Juan Diaz (136.4 for bantamweight) missed and still beat short-notice replacement Alateng Heili.
Bia Mesquita asked for a title shot after choking out Macy Chiasson in R1.
Uros Medic and Kevin Holland fought to a majority draw (29-27 Medic, 28-28, 28-28). Medic had a point taken in R2 for a second low blow, so without it he would have won.
Caio Borralho (MW #6) swept Yousri Belgaroui 30-27 on all cards with takedowns and control in every round.
Kayla Harrison choked out Amanda Nunes in R4 (1:29) to keep the women's bantamweight title in a clash of two legends.
Ciryl Gane kept the heavyweight title with a unanimous decision (48-47 x3) over Josh Hokit. Some outlets called it controversial: Gane landed far more strikes, Hokit had the control time.
Amanda Nunes returns from retirement to face Kayla Harrison, who is back from neck surgery.
